summary.text: Steve Bratcher is a Republican state representative who has represented Kentucky House of Representatives District 25 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An executive and Kentucky Air National Guard veteran, he is vice chair of the Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Protection Committee.

paragraphs.text: Steve Bratcher served in the Kentucky Air National Guard.

He earned associate degrees from the Community College of the Air Force, a bachelor's degree and master's degree from Eastern Kentucky University, and an executive master's degree in business administration from Bellarmine University.

His career experience includes working as director of external technical training at Elizabethtown Community and Technical College, as a director at Maker's Mark Distillery, and as a manager with Lear Corporation.
Bratcher took office in the Kentucky House on January 1, 2023, as the successor to Jim DuPlessis.

For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Health and Family Services, Primary and Secondary Education, and Postsecondary Education committees and was vice chair of the House Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Protection Committee.
The Republican primary for his seat on May 19, 2026, was canceled.
